metabolism.notes: CYP3A4 has strong activity for estradiol 2-hydroxylation (with CYP1A2 the principal hepatic oxidative pathway). Strong CYP3A4 inducers lower circulating estrogen, the basis of reduced contraceptive/HRT efficacy with enzyme inducers.
CYP1A2 has the highest activity for estradiol 2-hydroxylation. CYP1A2 induction (e.g. tobacco smoke) accelerates estradiol clearance and lowers levels.
